{"reason":"Add the supplied high-confidence gate and raise exposure from 500,000 to 700,000. This rejects all eight displayed false-arbitration rows: six have confidence 0.44–0.67, while the 0.83 and 0.91 cases expose only 680,000 and 690,000. It targets v1’s 0.714 false-arbitration rate while preserving eligible positives for the recall ≥0.8 gate.","source":"(define (should-arbitrate? edi-change inventory-exposure)
  (and (> (abs (change-pct edi-change)) 0.15)
       (> inventory-exposure 700000)
       (not (frozen-horizon? edi-change))
       (high-confidence? edi-change)))"}
